summary: The candidate correctly namespaces Mooncake SSD paths by dp/tp/pp rank for the legacy HiCacheController construction path and preserves the configured path when storage_config is absent. It is only a partial fix: the registered MooncakeDirectLinker construction path also creates MooncakeStore clients but does not propagate a DP rank, so the new default dp_rank=0 still aliases DP-attention clients that share local TP and PP ranks. The candidate also does not document the one-client-per-directory contract requested by the issue.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: the base HiCacheStorageConfig cannot accept dp_rank, producing three errors and demonstrating that DP identity cannot reach Mooncake path selection.
Candidate regression: three tests passed for DP/TP/PP path separation and absent SSD configuration.
Independent boundary checks: 12 distinct (dp,tp,pp) tuples produced 12 existing directories; storage_config=None passed the original configured path unchanged to Mooncake setup.
13 relevant mocked Mooncake unit tests passed.

tests.command: source inspection of python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/storage/mooncake_store/mooncake_direct_linker.py at candidate commit
tests.what_was_measured: MooncakeDirectLinker is registered and constructs HiCacheStorageConfig without dp_rank; the dataclass default is 0, leaving a same-local-TP/PP DP collision counterexample.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was visible through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but this path-selection defect is CPU configuration logic and no GPU kernel or model execution would validate the missing DP identity.

remaining_counterexamples: Two DP-attention workers using the registered MooncakeDirectLinker path with identical attention-local tp_rank and pp_rank both leave HiCacheStorageConfig.dp_rank at 0 and therefore select the same rank_0_<tp>_<pp> SSD directory.
The requested supported-model documentation for one Mooncake client per storage directory is absent.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4-Flash weights or TP8/multi-node allocation were available, so the production topology was not executed.

No live Mooncake master plus eight simultaneously created LOCAL_DISK clients was run; deterministic fake clients verified the SGLang setup paths, not Mooncake bucket corruption or restart re-adoption.
The Mooncake-side recovery/ownership change referenced by the issue was not part of candidate commit 2ffc47a4 and was not independently qualified.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python and report/test files.
